front: Two formulas for the dot product
back: $a\cdot b=\sum_i a_ib_i=\|a\|\|b\|\cos\theta$ (equal by the law of cosines).
$\dfrac{a\cdot b}{b\cdot b}\,b$. The residual $a-\operatorname{proj}_b a$ is orthogonal to $b$.

front: Cosine similarity: what does it ignore?
back: Vector length. $\cos\theta=\dfrac{a\cdot b}{\|a\|\|b\|}$ depends only on direction.
$|a\cdot b|\le\|a\|\|b\|$, equality iff one vector is a scalar multiple of the other.
`*` is elementwise (length $n$ result); `@` is the dot product (scalar).
